column3: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
column4:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.

column3: Speak with Vance Undergloom in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
column4: Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.\r\n\r\nI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

column3: Speak with Bowen Brisboise on the road to Brill from Deathknell to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
column4: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.\r\n\r\nI know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

column3: Collect $1oa Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
column4:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.

You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$n, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

column3: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
column4: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.\r\n\r\nOne of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

column3: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
column4: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.

column3: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
column4:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

column3: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
column4:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.

column3: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
column4: Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.\r\n\r\nI've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
